fields.contract: ArgentSeaGrainStorageDbProviderBuilder and ArgentSeaGrainStorageShardProviderBuilder are internal sealed IProviderBuilder<ISiloBuilder> implementations, one per backing store, registered for configuration-driven hosts under distinct provider types of category "GrainStorage" on the Silo side: the Shard builder as "ArgentSeaSql" and the Db builder as "ArgentSeaSqlDb" (Orleans keeps one builder per provider type, so a shared type would leave one unreachable). Each type's Configure(ISiloBuilder builder, string? dataProviderName, IConfigurationSection configurationSection) method registers the matching grain-storage factory against the builder's service collection under the supplied dataProviderName: the Db builder registers ArgentSeaGrainStorageFactory.CreateDb and sets the named OrleansDbPersistenceOptions.DatabaseKey, the Shard builder registers ArgentSeaGrainStorageFactory.CreateShards and sets the named OrleansShardPersistenceOptions.ShardSetKey. The key is resolved in order: the supplied configurationSection's DatabaseKey/ShardSetKey when present and non-empty; otherwise the same key in the application configuration's top-level "OrleansData" section; otherwise "Default". Precondition: when configurationSection does not supply the key, the "OrleansData" section must exist, or Configure throws InvalidOperationException. This is the declarative counterpart to ArgentSeaSiloBuilderExtensions' imperative registration calls; both ultimately register the same ArgentSeaGrainStorageFactory delegates under the same provider name.
fields.name: ArgentSeaGrainStorageProviderBuilder declarative grain-storage registration
